				Six.Texture = "http://www.roblox.com/asset/?id=0"

				Three.Face = "Right"
				Four.Face = "Left"
				Five.Face = "Top"
				Six.Face = "Bottom"

			exPro(v)

	end
	function Lokal(root)
		for _, v in pairs(root:GetChildren()) do

		end
	end
	exPro(game.Workspace)
	Lokal(game.Workspace)
end
